en.title: Purchasing Tournament Quotas & Validity Rules
en.excerpt: A friendly step-by-step guide to selecting tournament packages, topping up your event quota, instant payment activation, and understanding quota validity.
en.content:
Welcome to the Archeris quota management guide! To host and publish archery tournaments on Archeris, organizers use tournament quota slots. This guide explains our package tiers, how to complete secure purchases, instant quota activation, and how your data remains permanently safe.

Tournament Package Tiers

Archeris provides flexible package tiers tailored for club practices, regional cups, and national championships:

  • Free Tier (Starter Quota): Includes complimentary quota slots upon account registration so you can test scoring workflows, set up practice tournaments, and explore the organizer dashboard with zero upfront cost.
  • Standard Package (Up to 200 Archers): Ideal for club events, local invitationals, and regional stages. Includes full scoring, qualification targets, elimination brackets, and automated certificate generation.
  • Elite Package (Unlimited Archers): Designed for major national opens, multi-day championships, and grand prix events. Supports unlimited participants, extensive multi-category brackets, and dedicated priority support.

How to Purchase Quotas

To top up your tournament quotas in just a few clicks:

  1. Log in to your Organizer Dashboard.
  2. In the left sidebar, click Packages & Quota (/dashboard/organizer/package).
  3. Browse the tier cards and choose your desired package (Standard or Elite).
  4. Review the package features and click the Buy Quota button.
  5. Confirm your order summary in the checkout prompt to proceed to the secure payment gateway.

Supported Payment Methods

Payments are processed instantly through official financial payment gateways with end-to-end encryption:

  • QRIS: Instant QR code scanning compatible with BCA, Mandiri Livin, GoPay, OVO, ShopeePay, Dana, and LinkAja.
  • Virtual Accounts (Bank Transfer): Automated individual payment accounts for BCA, Bank Mandiri, BNI, BRI, and Permata Bank.
  • Credit & Debit Cards: Global Visa, Mastercard, and JCB cards secured by 3D Secure OTP verification.

Once payment is confirmed by your bank or e-wallet, our automated server webhook replenishes your quota balance within seconds without requiring manual admin approval.

Quota Validity & Usage Rules

Keep these essential points in mind regarding quota deduction and validity:

  • Quota Deduction: Exactly one tournament quota slot is deducted when you publish a tournament or launch live registration.
  • Draft Tournaments: Creating and configuring tournament drafts does not consume any quota until you publish the event.
  • Zero Balance State: When your quota balance reaches zero, you cannot publish new public tournaments. However, all existing and past tournaments remain completely functional.

Permanent Data Preservation Guarantee

Archeris guarantees that your tournament history is never deleted or locked away, even if your account has zero remaining quota:

  • Past Tournament Archives: All qualification scores, arrow-by-arrow logs, and elimination match trees remain publicly viewable and verifiable.
  • PDF Result Books: You can export and download official FITA/World Archery compliant result books at any time.
  • Participant Certificates: Archers and coaches can continue downloading their verified certificates of participation and achievement indefinitely.

Billing History & Invoicing

Track all your organization's expenses in one transparent place:

  • Every successful transaction is recorded in the Billing History table at the bottom of the Package page.
  • Official digital invoices and commercial receipts are generated automatically for your club's financial reconciliation and annual reports.
  • If a payment is completed but your balance does not refresh immediately, simply click refresh on your browser or reach out to Archeris support with your Order ID for instant assistance.
